title: Dating App Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Safety Score
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk on Tinder, Bumble, Grindr and other dating apps. Get personalized safety recommendations and improve your protection.
description: Assess your privacy vulnerability across dating platforms with our comprehensive risk calculator. Analyze your current settings, sharing habits, and security measures to get a personalized privacy score and actionable safety recommendations.

formula: const appMultiplier = appsUsed * 8; const locationRisk = locationSharing === 'disabled' ? 0 : locationSharing === 'approximate' ? 15 : locationSharing === 'precise' ? 25 : 35; const photoRisk = photoPrivacy === 'anonymous' ? 0 : photoPrivacy === 'limited_identifying' ? 10 : photoPrivacy === 'some_identifying' ? 20 : 30; const profileRisk = profileInfo === 'minimal' ? 5 : profileInfo === 'moderate' ? 15 : profileInfo === 'detailed' ? 25 : 35; const socialRisk = socialMediaLinked ? 20 : 0; const premiumRisk = premiumFeatures ? 10 : 0; const settingsRisk = privacySettings === 'maximum' ? 0 : privacySettings === 'enhanced' ? 5 : privacySettings === 'default' ? 15 : 20; const browserRisk = browserSecurity === 'private' || browserSecurity === 'vpn' ? 0 : browserSecurity === 'standard' ? 8 : 15; const totalRisk = Math.min(100, appMultiplier + locationRisk + photoRisk + profileRisk + socialRisk + premiumRisk + settingsRisk + browserRisk); const riskLevel = totalRisk <= 30 ? 'Low Risk' : totalRisk <= 60 ? 'Moderate Risk' : totalRisk <= 80 ? 'High Risk' : 'Critical Risk'; const concerns = []; if (locationRisk > 20) concerns.push('Location tracking'); if (photoRisk > 15) concerns.push('Photo identification'); if (socialRisk > 0) concerns.push('Social media exposure'); if (profileRisk > 20) concerns.push('Information oversharing'); if (settingsRisk > 10) concerns.push('Weak privacy settings'); return { riskScore: totalRisk, riskLevel: riskLevel, topConcerns: concerns.length > 0 ? concerns.join(', ') : 'Good privacy practices' };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates key privacy risk factors including app proliferation, location sharing, photo identification risks, information disclosure, social media linking, and security practices. Scores are weighted based on real-world privacy breach patterns and data harvesting methods used by dating platforms.
tips: Disable precise location sharing and use approximate location only
Avoid linking social media accounts to dating profiles
Use photos that don't reveal identifying landmarks or workplaces
Regularly audit and tighten privacy settings on all dating apps
Consider using Incognito Browser when accessing dating sites
Limit personal details in your profile to reduce tracking risks
Use different photos across platforms to prevent cross-platform tracking
Regularly review what data dating apps have collected about you
Consider using a separate email address for dating apps

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices with minimal exposure. Continue monitoring settings and stay vigilant about new features that may affect privacy.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy vulnerabilities present. Review location settings, photo choices, and consider reducing information shared across platforms.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure detected. Immediate action recommended to secure accounts, limit data sharing, and review all connected services.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Severe privacy vulnerabilities across multiple areas. Urgent privacy overhaul needed including settings review, account cleanup, and enhanced security measures.
